summary: The dog is inside, hurt, backing among the shelves; per round of work at the door it slams it on a 1 in 6.

Ruling for amw8k67wgx2fvwd: tables as in the sandbox GM ledger (dog slams on a 1 per round of work; two tacks, Dexterity DC 13 each round, up to five rounds; finished weld breaks on Strength 15+, +2 per earlier hit). Door shutting: the dog is hurt and backing away; it does not reach the gap (no roll).
GM error, disclosed: the weld was finished in round 4 (two tacks set: rounds 1 and 4). Rolls roll_t1_9 and roll_t1_10 (round 5) were made after it was done; they have no effect and are not used.
